title: IPTV Setup Guides: Firestick, Android TV, Smart TV & More
description: How to set up an IPTV player on Fire TV Stick, Android TV, Samsung and LG Smart TVs, Apple TV, iPhone, iPad and Android, using legal sources.
intro: Every device has its own quirks: sideloading on Fire TV, the Google Play catalogue on Android TV, the limited app stores on Samsung Tizen and LG webOS, and the strict rules of Apple's App Store. These guides show the supported route for each platform.

faq.question: Which device is easiest for IPTV?
faq.answer: Many devices can run an IPTV player app. Which players are available depends on the device's app store and your country, so check the store on your device before you choose a player.
